durable_goods_distribution_specialty.label: Durable-goods distribution specialty
durable_goods_distribution_specialty.value: Home medical equipment and supplies: sleep apnea (CPAP), respiratory/oxygen, mobility, ostomy/urology, wound care, nutrition, bracing

manufacturer_supplier_relationship.label: Manufacturer / supplier relationship
manufacturer_supplier_relationship.value: Partners with leading manufacturers and carries leading brands, e.g., continuous glucose monitors and insulin pumps; ostomy supplies from leading brands

technical_value_added_services.label: Technical / value-added services
technical_value_added_services.value: Clinician and product specialist guidance, sleep coaching, insurance verification and billing, managed refill schedules, in-home technician delivery and setup

aftermarket_sales_exposure.label: Aftermarket sales exposure
aftermarket_sales_exposure.value: Substantial recurring resupply of consumables, e.g., CPAP masks and ostomy supplies, alongside equipment rentals and sales

notes: AdaptHealth is a home medical equipment provider selling to patients and insurers rather than a classic distributor; facets fit loosely.
